general_skills.title: Case Analysis
general_skills.principle: Partition problems into distinct cases based on constraints or structural properties to explore all valid configurations systematically.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solutions involve interdependent conditions, categorical distinctions, or boundary cases.

general_skills.title: Constraint Application
general_skills.principle: Formalize and apply problem constraints through algebraic relationships, domain restrictions, or logical boundaries to narrow solution spaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems with bounded variables, equations involving non-negativity, or prime-dependent conditions.

general_skills.title: Optimization Techniques
general_skills.principle: Use extremal value assignments, ratio analysis, or fixed-sum relationships to maximize/minimize target functions under constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When optimizing sums, products, or packing density with bounded variable domains.

general_skills.title: Pattern Recognition
general_skills.principle: Identify recurring structures, sequences, or transformation rules to generalize solutions across layers or iterations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When repetitive operations or constraints exhibit consistent patterns that can be abstracted for broader application.

general_skills.title: Symmetry Utilization
general_skills.principle: Leverage symmetry properties to simplify problems or adjust counts for equivalent configurations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When dealing with symmetric figures, transformations, or equidistant geometric arrangements.

general_skills.title: Algebraic Manipulation
general_skills.principle: Transform complex expressions through substitution, factoring, or identity recognition to isolate variables or reveal simplifications.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When direct computation is obstructed by interdependent variables or complex term interactions.

general_skills.title: Geometric Analysis
general_skills.principle: Translate spatial relationships into algebraic equations or decompose shapes to reveal hidden structural properties.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When geometric intuition is insufficient, and symbolic manipulation or symmetry can clarify relationships.

general_skills.title: Solution Validation
general_skills.principle: Verify candidate solutions against all problem criteria and constraints to ensure mathematical and contextual correctness.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After generating potential solutions, exploring boundary cases, or resolving systems with multiple constraints.

general_skills.title: Number Theory
general_skills.principle: Apply divisibility rules, modular arithmetic, and prime factorization to analyze number properties and solve equations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When dealing with integer constraints, periodicity, or divisibility conditions.

general_skills.title: Recurrence Solving
general_skills.principle: Express recurrence relations as telescoping sums or solve linear recurrences using characteristic equations to derive closed-form solutions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solving sequences defined by overlapping functional equations or probabilistic steps.

general_skills.title: Combinatorial Analysis
general_skills.principle: Systematically enumerate configurations using case analysis, inclusion-exclusion, or constraint-driven partitioning.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When enumerating subsets, sequences, or arrangements with conditional constraints.

general_skills.title: Proportional Reasoning
general_skills.principle: Apply similarity scaling, proportional reasoning, or percentage changes to connect measurements or quantities.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When dealing with scaled figures, parallel lines, or multiplicative comparisons between quantities.

general_skills.title: Boundary Analysis
general_skills.principle: Evaluate extreme values or compare growth rates of equation sides to eliminate impossible solution ranges.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solving equations with mixed polynomial/exponential terms or analyzing behavior under extremal constraints.

general_skills.title: State Transition Analysis
general_skills.principle: Represent cyclic or symmetric systems as state machines to apply recurrence relations or matrix methods.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When problems involve periodic behavior or symmetric state interactions.

general_skills.title: Digit Pattern Enumeration
general_skills.principle: Decompose numbers by place value and aggregate digit occurrences across ranges for systematic counting.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When determining digit usage in structured numerical sequences.

general_skills.title: Resource Optimization
general_skills.principle: Identify maximum demand for individual components to determine required resource quantities.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When resources are bundled to cover multiple components with variable dependencies.

general_skills.title: Behavioral Constraint Analysis
general_skills.principle: Leverage monotonicity, extrema, or asymptotic properties to validate solutions in optimization or parameter estimation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When multiple solutions exist in exponential/logarithmic contexts requiring additional constraints.

general_skills.title: Verification by Perturbation
general_skills.principle: Test small deviations from a candidate solution to confirm optimality or completeness.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After deriving a potential solution to ensure no better option exists.

general_skills.title: Probability Techniques
general_skills.principle: Compute expectations using ratio constraints, apply geometric distributions for waiting times, or use union bounds for probability estimates.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solving for expectations under variable relationships or estimating bounds for intersecting events.

general_skills.title: Logarithmic Techniques
general_skills.principle: Convert logarithmic expressions to exponential forms or apply identities to uncover variable relationships and simplify complex equations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solving logarithmic equations, transforming multiplicative relationships into sums, or comparing exponential growth.

general_skills.title: Problem Decomposition
general_skills.principle: Break complex problems into sequential subproblems or independent components for modular analysis.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For multi-step problems requiring isolated solution steps.

general_skills.title: Number Property Analysis
general_skills.principle: Filter cases or simplify expressions using divisibility, modular arithmetic, or integer classification.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving number characteristics, remainders, or factorization.

general_skills.title: Algebraic Simplification
general_skills.principle: Reduce complexity by simplifying expressions, solving equations, or applying identities.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For structured numerical patterns or intractable expressions.

general_skills.title: Combinatorial Counting
general_skills.principle: Systematically count configurations by iterating through constraints or categorizing arrangements.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For permutation problems, distribution scenarios, or path enumeration with exclusion rules.

general_skills.title: Probability Modeling
general_skills.principle: Calculate probabilities by aggregating weighted outcomes under probabilistic constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving random variable distributions or sequential state transitions.

general_skills.title: Geometric Reasoning
general_skills.principle: Model spatial relationships through coordinate systems or geometric properties for algebraic solutions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving distances, coordinates, or variable-parameter geometry.

general_skills.title: Function Analysis
general_skills.principle: Determine solution counts by examining function ranges, critical points, and monotonicity.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For parameterized equations requiring solution behavior analysis.

general_skills.title: Iterative Analysis
general_skills.principle: Examine recursive processes by identifying invariants, termination conditions, or transformation patterns.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For recursive functions, sequences, or state transitions with evolving parameters.

general_skills.title: Edge Case Evaluation
general_skills.principle: Identify parameter values causing degeneracy and adjust solution ranges to ensure uniqueness.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When multiple solutions exist, check for parameter values reducing solution count to one.

general_skills.title: Modular Arithmetic
general_skills.principle: Use modular arithmetic to simplify calculations, verify divisibility, or solve congruences through periodicity.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving last digits, cyclic patterns, or divisibility constraints.

general_skills.title: Inequality Analysis
general_skills.principle: Combine inequalities to establish direct variable relationships and resolve contradictions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems with interdependent inequalities or variable constraints.

general_skills.title: Equation Resolution
general_skills.principle: Solve systems of equations through substitution, elimination, or parameterization to satisfy interdependent constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For multi-variable problems requiring variable isolation or constraint satisfaction.

general_skills.title: Expression Simplification
general_skills.principle: Apply algebraic identities or functional transformations to reduce mathematical expressions to simpler forms.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving radicals, polynomials, or trigonometric functions.

general_skills.title: Probabilistic Reasoning
general_skills.principle: Aggregate weighted outcomes under probabilistic constraints to compute expected values or state transitions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems with random variable distributions or state transition systems.

general_skills.title: Digit Decomposition
general_skills.principle: Break numbers into positional components to form algebraic representations of digit patterns.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When solving problems with positional constraints or digit-based patterns.

general_skills.title: Prime Constraint Analysis
general_skills.principle: Verify primality conditions or solve equations with prime number constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems requiring prime divisors with specific sum/product properties.

general_skills.title: Reverse Process Modeling
general_skills.principle: Work backward from target states by applying inverse operations with periodic adjustments.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For staged modification problems with deletion or transformation patterns.

general_skills.title: Solution Space Construction
general_skills.principle: Generate candidate solutions using parameterized families that satisfy structural constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For Diophantine equations or integer solution patterns.

general_skills.title: Integer Scaling Optimization
general_skills.principle: Minimize target quantities by testing minimal integer scaling parameters with common factors.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems requiring proportional integer solutions with common factors.

general_skills.title: Non-Negativity Enforcement
general_skills.principle: Use non-negative term summation properties to enforce uniqueness in equations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For equations involving squares, absolute values, or non-negative expressions.

general_skills.title: Fractional Simplification
general_skills.principle: Combine and reduce fractions to compute numerator-denominator sums or simplified forms.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For final answers requiring reduced fractional forms.

general_skills.title: Domain Constraint Application
general_skills.principle: Limit analysis to feasible domains using function bounds and variable constraints.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For equations with bounded functions and variable interactions.

general_skills.title: Boundary Case Testing
general_skills.principle: Validate solutions through minimal values, edge cases, or exceptional scenarios.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For minimal solutions, constraint validation, or pattern exceptions.

general_skills.title: Periodic Pattern Analysis
general_skills.principle: Leverage periodicity to infer solution counts from localized intervals.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For equations with trigonometric or symmetric periodic structures.

general_skills.title: Geometric Constraint Modeling
general_skills.principle: Formulate algebraic equations from geometric relationships and properties.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems with multiple geometric constraints requiring algebraic formulation.

general_skills.title: Tangency Relationship Derivation
general_skills.principle: Use geometric perpendicularity properties to derive solution relationships.
general_skills.when_to_apply: For problems involving circles, lines, and tangent curves.

common_mistakes.description: Assuming unverified mathematical relationships or properties.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent conflates problem elements, assumes properties without proof, or applies theorems without verifying their conditions, leading to invalid conclusions.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Derive relationships rigorously, confirm theorem applicability, and test edge cases before proceeding.

common_mistakes.description: Overlooking edge cases or missing scenarios.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent neglects boundary conditions, fails to account for all valid cases, or miscalculates counts due to incomplete enumeration.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Systematically enumerate all potential cases, including edge cases, and validate against problem constraints.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent misreads key terms, overlooks implicit constraints, or misaligns definitions with problem requirements.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Carefully parse problem language, map terms to definitions, and validate interpretations against logical structure.

common_mistakes.description: Incorrect application of series or telescoping techniques.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Errors occur in partial fraction decomposition, telescoping setup, or index alignment, leading to invalid summation results.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Verify decomposition steps, ensure telescoping alignment with summation bounds, and test intermediate results.

common_mistakes.description: Overlooking constraints in permutations or subsets.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent ignores ordering constraints or misapplies combinatorial logic, resulting in invalid configurations.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Explicitly enforce all problem-specific constraints during combinatorial analysis and validate configurations.

common_mistakes.description: Misunderstanding conditional probability or percentage requirements.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent confuses absolute percentages with conditional probabilities or misinterprets subset relationships.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Clarify the probabilistic structure and ensure calculations reflect the correct base set for each condition.

common_mistakes.description: Failing to validate answers against constraints or format.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent concludes without checking alignment with required formats, numerical constraints, or logical consistency.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Cross-check final answers against all problem requirements, including formatting and constraints.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent applies complex techniques without verifying their relevance, introducing errors in derivation.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Use advanced methods only when their applicability is clear and verify intermediate steps with simpler approaches.
